quotes.text: Use `billing_cycle_anchor_config` to calculate the timestamp for you (monthly or yearly subscriptions only).
To reset the billing cycle anchor to the current time, make an update request with `billing_cycle_anchor.type` set to `now`.

If your subscription uses `billing_mode[type]=flexible`, resetting the billing cycle anchor to `now` doesn’t automatically generate a new invoice. To trigger an invoice on a BCA reset, you must also set `proration_behavior` to `always_invoice`.
The ability to reset the billing period to a specific time is in [private preview](https://docs.stripe.com/release-phases.md).
You can only reset the billing cycle anchor to a specific time for subscriptions that use [flexible billing mode](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/billing-mode/compare.md).

findings: The same-URL November guide retains billing-cycle fundamentals: price interval plus anchor determine renewal dates, billing_cycle_anchor_config calculates monthly/yearly dates and handles short months, while direct billing_cycle_anchor accepts a timestamp including daily/weekly schedules (new lines 11-41, 64-85, 87-113; old lines 10-40, 83-114, 116-158).

On creation, an initial prorated invoice is described by default; proration_behavior none gives an initial free period without an invoice until the first full period. Subscriptions API may combine trial_end and anchor, whereas Checkout subscription mode does not support that combination and disallows one-time prices with proration_behavior none (new lines 115-149; old lines 160-207).

For existing subscriptions, November adds a specific-timestamp reset as private preview, with API 2026-09-30.preview, flexible mode requirement, interval-bound limits, and proration behavior (new lines 192-237). It also changes reset-to-now API shape and explains the flexible-mode invoice exception (new lines 165-183).

The current source is discoverable through wiki/index.md, wiki/stripe-index.md:622 and wiki/concepts/stripe-subscriptions.md:227, but its reset-to-now code and two-options summary are dated to May and incomplete for the November capture.
substantive_changes: The November reset-to-now update uses billing_cycle_anchor.type=now and the example pins Stripe-Version 2026-09-30.endive (new lines 167-183), replacing the May scalar billing_cycle_anchor='now' Node.js example (old lines 224-239). Do not silently treat these as interchangeable across API versions.

The new flexible-mode warning says a reset to now does not automatically invoice; always_invoice is needed, except when a simultaneous item change leaves non-canceling prorations, which immediately invoices regardless of proration_behavior (new lines 169-171). The older generic immediate-invoice wording lacked that qualification (old line 224).

A new specific-timestamp reset is private preview for flexible-billing subscriptions only, requires API 2026-09-30.preview, allows an anchor within one price interval of now subject to smallest mixed interval and post-trial-end rules, and can create credits/debits according to proration settings (new lines 192-237). It is not a generally available replacement for ordinary direct timestamp on creation.

The Dashboard reset-to-now and trial UI instructions changed (old lines 241-246, 275-288; new lines 185-190, 262-268). Node.js examples became curl, links and formatting changed, and an optional test-clock link was added; these alone do not establish lifecycle behavior changes (diff lines 1-386).
historical_claims_to_preserve: Keep May 2026's scalar billing_cycle_anchor='now' example and the then-shown Dashboard Bill today instead and trial-end missing-payment-method choices as dated old-capture details (old lines 224-246, 275-288). Their absence in November's shortened UI rendering does not prove deprecation or removal.

Preserve the existing monthly/yearly config rules, UTC and backdating limits, first-full-invoice timing, Checkout trial-plus-anchor restriction, trial_end anchor update, and auto-reset conditions with the same document's dated evidence (old lines 29-114, 160-220, 248-262; new lines 30-85, 115-163, 239-253).
conflicts: Current source lines 13 and 30-34 say there are only two existing-subscription methods and show update({billing_cycle_anchor:'now'}). November adds a private-preview third method and uses billing_cycle_anchor.type=now for the pinned endive example (new lines 153-175, 192-224). Narrow the summary to public methods plus a separately qualified preview and version the code.

Current source line 40 says flexible mode keeps the anchor unchanged when the billing period changes; November's explicit flexible-mode reset-to-now behavior and timestamp preview show this is not a blanket ban on requested resets (new lines 159, 169-171, 210-213). Preserve the auto-reset distinction.

wiki/concepts/stripe-subscriptions.md Billing Cycle Anchor section says trials and anchors are mutually exclusive without saying Checkout. This same source documents trial_end with anchor for Subscriptions API and says Checkout cannot combine them (new lines 121-144; old lines 166-202). Qualify the concept to Checkout.

Current source line 24 says the first invoice always falls within one period; both raws specifically say first full invoice, and the anchor may be farther away (new lines 83-85; old lines 112-114). Correct invoice type to avoid collapsing prorated and full invoice timing.
unresolved_questions: The guide's private-preview description does not establish enrollment, account eligibility, or successful acceptance of a particular timestamp reset.

The May Dashboard trial configuration listed missing-payment-method outcomes, while the November capture omits them; this comparison cannot establish whether the UI options or underlying behavior were removed.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/billing-cycle, the November capture explains that price intervals and billing-cycle anchors set renewal dates; monthly/yearly config calculates calendar-safe anchors, while direct timestamps cover other intervals (new lines 11-41, 64-85). Creation usually prorates the initial period, and existing subscriptions can reset to now or use trial_end; Checkout's trial-plus-anchor combination is restricted (new lines 115-175, 239-253). Compared with May, the new guide adds a private-preview specific-time reset and a flexible-mode invoice exception (old lines 209-239; new lines 165-237). [[source-stripe-subscriptions-billing-cycle]] currently summarizes the May two-method model and scalar reset example.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/billing-cycle, substantive changes are endive-version billing_cycle_anchor.type=now, the flexible-mode requirement for always_invoice on a reset-to-now except a stated simultaneous-item case, and a private-preview timestamp reset restricted to flexible billing with API 2026-09-30.preview and interval/trial limits (old lines 224-239; new lines 167-237). [[source-stripe-subscriptions-billing-cycle]] should keep its older scalar example and Dashboard choices dated, since omitted UI steps are not deprecation (old lines 241-288; new lines 185-190, 262-268). Node-to-curl examples and link edits are presentational. Customer v1 and Accounts v2 references remain distinct (new lines 9, 95-113), and preview visibility is no proof of account eligibility or payment outcome.
